remarks: Escape to your own peaceful wooded retreat! Situated on two parcels totaling approximately 9.82 acres, this Franklinville property offers a wonderful setting for hunting, camping, recreation, or simply enjoying the outdoors. Located within 5 miles from thousands of state land acreage! Tucked among the trees is a charming small camp constructed from hemlock, providing a cozy place to relax after a day in the woods. The camp is heated by a wood stove that has been inspected to code and is wired for future electric service, with wiring completed to code. A storage shed provides convenient space for your outdoor gear and equipment, and the wood currently at the property will remain with the sale. Whether you're looking for your own hunting getaway, weekend camping retreat, or a private piece of wooded land to enjoy year-round, this property offers plenty of possibilities. Two parcels being sold together for a combined 9.82 acres.
